from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json, os, statistics, subprocess, time

base = Path.cwd()
task = base / '.local/tool-tasks/tainted-card-continuation-20261007'
evidence = json.loads((base / 'docs/performance/zero-credit-growth-hp-pruning-20261007.json').read_text())
artifacts = {'A': base / '.local/tool-tasks/zero-credit-growth-proof-validation-20261007/build-final-v2/CombatSolver.dll', 'C': task / 'build-candidate/CombatSolver.dll'}
hashes = {'A': evidence['deployment']['candidateDllSha256'], 'C': hashlib.sha256(artifacts['C'].read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
records = []
for scene in ['dev-04-necrobinder-elite', 'dev-00-ironclad-elite']:
    template = next(r['plan'] for r in evidence['performance']['finalRuns'] if r['scene'] == scene and r['label'] == 'C1')
    for label in ['A1', 'C1', 'C2', 'A2']:
        out = task / 'pure-target' / scene / label
        out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        cmd = template['command'].copy()
        cmd[cmd.index('--out') + 1] = str(out)
        cmd[cmd.index('--label') + 1] = 'tainted-continuation-' + scene + '-' + label
        env = os.environ.copy()
        for key in list(env):
            if key.startswith('OFFLINE_HARNESS_') or key.startswith('COMBATSOLVER_VERIFY') or key in ['DOTNET_PerfMapEnabled', 'COMPlus_PerfMapEnabled', 'COMBATSOLVER_MEASUREMENT_TRACE']:
                env.pop(key, None)
        env['OFFLINE_HARNESS_COMBATSOLVER_DLL'] = str(artifacts[label[0]])
        plan = {'scene': scene, 'label': label, 'command': cmd, 'outerTimeoutSeconds': 120, 'dllSha256': hashes[label[0]], 'requestSha256': template['requestSha256'], 'requestHashReuse': 'Unchanged frozen request, previously successful evidence.', 'noProfilerOrCorrectnessInstrumentation': True}
        (out / 'command.json').write_text(json.dumps(plan, indent=2) + '\n')
        started = time.monotonic()
        with (out / 'launcher.log').open('w') as log:
            proc = subprocess.Popen(cmd, env=env, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
            try:
                code = proc.wait(timeout=120)
                status = 'Completed' if code == 0 else 'Failed'
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                proc.kill()
                proc.wait()
                code, status = proc.returncode, 'TimeoutNoRetry'
        record = {'scene': scene, 'label': label, 'status': status, 'exitCode': code, 'launcherWallSeconds': time.monotonic() - started, 'path': str(out / 'result.json'), 'plan': plan}
        if status == 'Completed':
            result = json.loads((out / 'result.json').read_text())
            record.update({k: result[k] for k in ['wallSeconds', 'peakProcessWorkingSetBytes', 'comparisonQuality', 'budget', 'solverMetrics', 'pruneCounters', 'timeBoundaryObserved']})
            record['rootStampSha256'] = hashlib.sha256(result['rootContinuationStamp'].encode()).hexdigest()
            record['policy'] = json.loads((out / 'search-policy.json').read_text())
        records.append(record)
        (task / 'pure-target-summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(records, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
        print(json.dumps({k: record.get(k) for k in ['scene', 'label', 'status', 'wallSeconds', 'peakProcessWorkingSetBytes', 'comparisonQuality']}, ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)
        if status != 'Completed':
            raise SystemExit('Terminal result retained; no unchanged retry or timeout enlargement.')
